title: dahlia pinnata var. gracilis
intro: Dahlia pinnata var. gracilis, commonly known as the Bitter Dahlia, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Dahlia pinnata var. gracilis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
